the_claim_this_supports: This block was mined AFTER the receiver was air-gapped and evidenced. It therefore did not exist anywhere when that machine lost its network, and cannot have been pre-staged, cached or synced onto it. If it appears on the receiver, the radio is the only channel by which it could have arrived.
no_competing_miner: The operator stopped 'generate coins' in the VM before disconnecting it, so no other miner was working this chain. The block is uncontested and cannot be orphaned mid-experiment.
